ICS 73.060.10MTD 13Reaffirmed 20231. SCOPE1.1 This standard specifies the methods to be followed for the determination of the degradation index of iron oxides’ lump ores, sinter and pellets. Section 1 and Section 2 of this standard prescribe method for the determination for degradation index under static bed followed by cold tumbling whereas Section 3 of this standard prescribes the method for the determination for degradation index during tumbling.2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. Allstandards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.460 Specification for test sieves:(Part 1) : 1985 Wire cloth test sieves (third revision)(Part 2) : 1985 Perforated plate test sieves (third revision)1405 : 2010 Iron ores — Sampling and sample- Preparation manual method (third revision)1607 : 2013 Methods for test sieving (second revision)
